items.review_rationale: Read the roots-based equivalent criterion for two coprime polynomials over arbitrary k, ensuring common zeros are tested in an algebraic closure rather than only in k itself.

references.phrase: polynomial f or g over k
references.context: Element of univariate polynomial algebra k[x], evaluated after scalar extension into the algebraic closure.

references.phrase: common zero of f and g
references.context: Element α in an algebraic closure of k satisfying f(α)=0=g(α).

references.phrase: coprimality iff absence of common algebraic-closure root
references.disposition: Univariate polynomial equivalence over a field; k-rational roots alone do not suffice for this criterion.

items.review_rationale: Read Hausdorff separation for every pair of distinct points with two disjoint open neighborhoods, without assuming compactness, metrizability or discrete topology.

references.context: Open set in the given topology that contains the specified point.

references.phrase: disjoint open neighborhoods of distinct points
references.context: For any x≠y, find open U containing x and V containing y with U∩V=∅.

references.disposition: The separation property applies to every distinct pair; it does not require singleton sets to be open.
